"""Frozen TACT5 OCR observations with physical field identities."""

import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from extract_families.tact5_process import extract_tact5
from raw_contract import canonical_hash, import_raw_package, validate_raw_record

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PROFILE = "tact5.process_settings.injection_holding_metering"
VERSION = "0.6.0"
DEFINITION = "contracts/raw-pages/tact5-process-0.6.0.json"
FILES = ("scripts/raw_tact5.py", "scripts/extract_families/tact5_process.py",
         "scripts/extract_families/common.py", "scripts/extract_families/coordinates.py",
         "scripts/quality.py", "scripts/raw_contract.py")


def build_tact5_package(root=ROOT):
    root = Path(root)
    definition = json.loads((root / DEFINITION).read_text())
    template = json.loads((root / "templates/raw-recognizers/tact5.process_ocr.v2/0.6.0/template.json").read_text())
    template.update(version=VERSION, extractor="registered_extractor", extractor_id="tact5.process_settings",
                    extractor_version="1", page_identity=dict(definition["page_identity"],
                    evidence_sample_ids=[sample["sample_id"] for sample in definition["samples"]]))
    contract = json.loads((root / "contracts/page_observations.v2.schema.json").read_text())
    sources = {path: (ROOT / path).read_text() for path in FILES}
    files = {path: hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest() for path, source in sources.items()}
    return dict(package_schema="hmi_raw_page_package.v2", profile_id=PROFILE, version=VERSION,
                template=template, raw_contract=contract, raw_contract_sha256=canonical_hash(contract),
                raw_field_definition=definition, raw_field_definition_sha256=canonical_hash(definition),
                recognizer=dict(id="tact5.process_ocr.v2", files=files, sources=sources,
                                sha256=canonical_hash(files)), samples=[dict(
                    manifest=dict(sample, profile_id=PROFILE, original_sha256=sample["image_sha256"]),
                    ocr=json.loads((root / sample["ocr"]).read_text())) for sample in definition["samples"]])


def tact5_package(root=ROOT, version=VERSION):
    if version != VERSION:
        raise ValueError("RAW_PAGE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED")
    package = import_raw_package(json.loads(
        (Path(root) / "templates/raw-packages" / PROFILE / f"{version}.json").read_text()))
    if package != build_tact5_package(root):
        raise ValueError("RAW_PACKAGE_FROZEN_CONTENT_MISMATCH")
    return package


def observe_tact5_page(lines, meta, image_sha256, rectified_image=None, root=ROOT):
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", image_sha256):
        raise ValueError("IMAGE_HASH_INVALID")
    package = tact5_package(root)
    extractor_lines = [dict(line, conf=line.get("conf", line.get("confidence", 0)),
                      bbox=line["bbox"] if isinstance(line["bbox"], dict) else
                      dict(zip(("x_min", "y_min", "x_max", "y_max"), line["bbox"]))) for line in lines]
    if rectified_image is None:
        legacy = extract_tact5(extractor_lines, package["template"], meta)
    else:
        import cv2
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="tact5-state-", dir=os.environ.get("AP_GRAPH_OUTPUT_DIR")) as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "screen.png"
            if not cv2.imwrite(str(path), rectified_image):
                raise ValueError("RECTIFIED_IMAGE_WRITE_FAILED")
            legacy = extract_tact5(extractor_lines, package["template"], meta, path)
    candidates = legacy["detail"]["page_observations"]
    fields, issues = [], []
    for spec in package["raw_field_definition"]["fields"]:
        hits = [field for field in candidates["fields"] if field["label"].casefold() == spec["label"].casefold()]
        observed = hits[0] if len(hits) == 1 else None
        value = observed["value"] if observed else None
        unit = observed["unit"] if observed else None
        confidence = observed["confidence"] if observed else None
        reading = ("unsupported" if spec.get("unsupported_reason") else "conflict" if len(hits) > 1
                   else "missing" if value is None else "uncertain" if confidence < .8 else "known")
        if unit is not None and unit != spec.get("unit"):
            reading = "conflict"
            issues.append(dict(code="UNIT_CONFLICT", screen_field_key=spec["screen_field_key"]))
        if reading != "known":
            issues.append(dict(code="FIELD_" + reading.upper(), screen_field_key=spec["screen_field_key"],
                               reason=spec.get("unsupported_reason")))
        label_indexes = observed["line_indexes"][:2 if spec.get("compound_label") else 1] if observed else []
        field = dict(screen_field_key=spec["screen_field_key"], source="image_recognition",
                     original_label=" ".join(lines[i]["text"] for i in label_indexes) or None,
                     original_value=value, original_unit=unit, effective_unit=unit or spec.get("unit"),
                     role=spec["role"], state=observed["state"] if observed else "unknown", reading=reading,
                     section=spec["section"], stage=spec.get("stage"), segment_id=spec.get("segment_id"),
                     confidence=confidence, text=observed["text"] if observed else None,
                     bbox=observed["bbox"] if observed else None,
                     original_bbox=observed["original_bbox"] if observed else None,
                     line_indexes=observed["line_indexes"] if observed else [],
                     state_basis=observed.get("state_basis") if observed else None,
                     reasons=observed["reasons"] if observed else [],
                     template_ref=dict(profile_id=PROFILE, version=VERSION,
                                       sha256=package["raw_field_definition_sha256"],
                                       unit=spec.get("unit") if unit is None else None))
        if len(hits) > 1:
            field["candidates"] = copy.deepcopy(hits)
        if spec.get("time_kind"):
            field["time_kind"] = spec["time_kind"]
        fields.append(field)
    for spec in package["raw_field_definition"]["fields"]:
        if not spec.get("stage"):
            continue
        group = [field for field in fields if field["section"] == spec["section"]
                 and field["screen_field_key"].rsplit(".", 1)[0] == spec["screen_field_key"].rsplit(".", 1)[0]
                 and field["bbox"]]
        group.sort(key=lambda field: field["bbox"][0])
        for order, field in enumerate(group, 1):
            field["order"] = order
    transform = copy.deepcopy(meta)
    transform.update(rectifier_input_sha256=meta.get("original_sha256"), original_sha256=image_sha256)
    record = dict(schema_version="page_observations.v2", profile_id=PROFILE, source="image_recognition",
                  page_identity=package["raw_field_definition"]["page_identity"],
                  image_sha256=image_sha256, original_size=meta.get("original_size"),
                  coordinate_space="original_percent", transform=transform,
                  raw_contract_sha256=package["raw_contract_sha256"],
                  raw_field_definition_sha256=package["raw_field_definition_sha256"],
                  raw_field_definition_version=VERSION, package_sha256=canonical_hash(package),
                  recognizer=package["recognizer"], engine={"library": "provided_ocr_sidecar"},
                  stage_counts=candidates["stage_counts"], visual_stage_counts=candidates["visual_stage_counts"],
                  fields=fields, issues=issues,
                  coverage=dict(status="partial" if issues else "complete",
                                missing=[field["screen_field_key"] for field in fields if field["reading"] == "missing"],
                                unsupported=[field["screen_field_key"] for field in fields if field["reading"] == "unsupported"]),
                  ocr_evidence=dict(coordinate_space="rectified_pixels", screen_size=meta["screen_size"], lines=lines))
    validate_raw_record(record, package)
    return record

"""提取 TACT5 组合工艺页的字段观测；不把未知启用状态当作有效设定。"""
import re
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np

from .common import bbox_grayscale_contrast
from .coordinates import project_boxes

NUMBER = re.compile(r'([+-]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\.\d+))\s*(mm/s|MPa|rpm|mm|s|段)?', re.I)


def _visual_stage_states(rows, gray):
    """比较已定位的 V 段数值格；仅在亮格与灰格分界唯一且清晰时判定各段状态。"""
    stages = sorted(rows)
    if gray is None or len(stages) < 4:
        return {}
    values = [bbox_grayscale_contrast(gray, rows[stage]['bbox']) for stage in stages]
    if any(value is None for value in values):
        return {}
    candidates = []
    for split in range(2, len(values) - 1):
        active, disabled = values[:split], values[split:]
        gap = min(active) - max(disabled)
        if gap >= 25 and min(active) >= 1.6 * max(disabled) and \
                max(max(active) - min(active), max(disabled) - min(disabled)) <= gap / 2:
            candidates.append(split)
    if len(candidates) != 1:
        return {}
    split = candidates[0]
    return {stage: 'enabled' if index < split else 'disabled'
            for index, stage in enumerate(stages)}


def _visual_retract_states(proposals, uses, gray):
    """以本页 PB 计量格为亮度基准，核对计量前后速度和距离是否同时启用或禁用。"""
    # shortcut: 仅用本页 PB1/PB2/PB3 作亮度基准；扩展到其他布局时须重新标定。
    if gray is None:
        return {}
    boxes = {}
    for label, spec, match in proposals:
        if match and uses[match[0]['index']] == 1 and min(label['confidence'], match[0]['confidence']) >= .8:
            boxes.setdefault(spec.get('label', label['text']), []).append(match[0]['bbox'])

    def brightness(name):
        """计算唯一数值格相对上方背景的亮度差；框缺失或无效时返回未知。"""
        candidates = boxes.get(name, [])
        if len(candidates) != 1 or bbox_grayscale_contrast(gray, candidates[0]) is None:
            return None
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = map(int, candidates[0])
        height = y2 - y1
        if y1 < height:
            return None
        return float(np.percentile(gray[y1:y2, x1:x2], 85) - np.median(gray[y1-height:y1, x1:x2]))

    reference = [brightness(name) for name in ('PB1', 'PB2', 'PB3')]
    if any(value is None for value in reference):
        return {}
    active, *grey = reference
    if active - max(grey) < 25 or max(grey) - min(grey) > 15:
        return {}
    midpoint = (active + sum(grey) / len(grey)) / 2
    states = {}
    for phase in ('计量前', '计量后'):
        values = [brightness(phase + kind) for kind in ('速度', '距离')]
        if any(value is None or abs(value - midpoint) < 3 for value in values):
            continue
        if all(value > midpoint for value in values):
            states[phase] = 'enabled'
        elif all(value < midpoint for value in values):
            states[phase] = 'disabled'
    return states


def extract_tact5(lines, template, meta, image_path=None):
    """按组合页模板关联 OCR 标签、数值、单位与段状态，组织待人工复核的 Reader 字段观测。"""
    width, height = meta['screen_size']
    cells = []
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        box = line['bbox']
        cells.append(dict(text=line['text'].strip(), confidence=float(line['conf']), index=index,
                          bbox=[box[k] for k in ('x_min', 'y_min', 'x_max', 'y_max')]))

    def center(cell):
        """求 OCR 文本框中心，供标签和数值的位置匹配使用。"""
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = cell['bbox']
        return (x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2

    def nearby(label, direction):
        """寻找标签右侧或下方的数字候选；是否唯一由调用处判断。"""
        lx, ly = center(label)
        lh = label['bbox'][3] - label['bbox'][1]
        found = []
        for cell in cells:
            match = NUMBER.fullmatch(cell['text'])
            if not match or cell is label:
                continue
            x, y = center(cell)
            if direction == 'below':
                fits = -.005*width <= cell['bbox'][0] - label['bbox'][0] <= width*.065 and lh*.35 < y-ly < lh*2.2
            else:
                fits = 0 < cell['bbox'][0] - label['bbox'][2] < width * .07 and abs(y - ly) < lh * .8
            if fits:
                found.append((cell, match))
        return found

    observations = []
    counts = {}
    for section, label_text in [('injection', '充填速度'), ('holding', '保压'), ('pressure', '限制压力')]:
        labels = [c for c in cells if c['text'].lstrip('◀◁< ') == label_text]
        matches = nearby(labels[0], 'below') if len(labels) == 1 else []
        matches = [(c, m) for c, m in matches if c['confidence'] >= .8 and float(m[1]).is_integer() and
                   1 <= float(m[1]) <= template['stage_limits'].get(section, 3)]
        if len(matches) == 1:
            counts[section] = (int(float(matches[0][1][1])), matches[0][0])
    vs1 = [c for c in cells if c['text'] == 'VS1']
    if len(vs1) == 1:
        x, y = center(vs1[0])
        options = [(c, NUMBER.fullmatch(c['text'])) for c in cells]
        options = [(c, m) for c, m in options if m and c['confidence'] >= .8 and
                   float(m[1]).is_integer() and 1 <= float(m[1]) <= 3 and
                   abs(center(c)[0] - x) < width * .08 and 0 < y-center(c)[1] < height * .12]
        if len(options) == 1:
            counts['plasticizing'] = (int(float(options[0][1][1])), options[0][0])

    proposals = []
    for label in cells:
        spec = next((spec for name, spec in template['field_labels'].items() if name.casefold() == label['text'].casefold()), None)
        if spec is not None:
            matches = nearby(label, spec['direction'])
            proposals.append((label, spec, matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None))
    for header_name in ('计量前', '计量后'):
        headers = [c for c in cells if c['text'] == header_name]
        if len(headers) != 1:
            continue
        header = headers[0]
        for row_name, unit in [('速度', 'mm/s'), ('距离', 'mm')]:
            rows = [c for c in cells if c['text'] == row_name and
                    0 < center(c)[1] - center(header)[1] < height*.12 and
                    0 < header['bbox'][0] - c['bbox'][2] < width*.12]
            if len(rows) != 1:
                continue
            row = rows[0]
            matches = [(c, NUMBER.fullmatch(c['text'])) for c in cells]
            matches = [(c, m) for c, m in matches if m and
                       abs(center(c)[0] - center(header)[0]) < width*.035 and
                       abs(center(c)[1] - center(row)[1]) < height*.018]
            spec = dict(section='scalar', unit=unit, role='setting', label=header_name + row_name,
                        row_index=row['index'])
            proposals.append((header, spec, matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None))
    uses = Counter(match[0]['index'] for _, _, match in proposals if match)
    gray = None
    if image_path is not None:
        import cv2
        gray = cv2.imread(str(image_path), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
        if gray is not None and gray.shape[::-1] != tuple(meta['screen_size']):
            gray = None
    visual_counts = {}
    visual_states = {}
    retract_states = _visual_retract_states(proposals, uses, gray)
    if gray is not None:
        rows = {}
        duplicate = False
        for label, spec, match in proposals:
            name = label['text'].casefold()
            if (match and uses[match[0]['index']] == 1 and
                    min(label['confidence'], match[0]['confidence']) >= .8 and re.fullmatch(r'v\d+', name)
                    and spec.get('section') == 'injection'):
                duplicate = duplicate or spec['stage'] in rows
                rows[spec['stage']] = match[0]
        if not duplicate:
            visual_states = _visual_stage_states(rows, gray)
            limit = template['stage_limits']['injection']
            if visual_states and set(visual_states) == set(range(1, limit + 1)):
                visual_counts['injection'] = sum(state == 'enabled' for state in visual_states.values())
    visual_conflict = 'injection' in counts and any(
        (stage <= counts['injection'][0]) != (state == 'enabled')
        for stage, state in visual_states.items())
    for label, spec, match in proposals:
        chosen = match if match and uses[match[0]['index']] == 1 else None
        value = float(chosen[1][1]) if chosen else None
        unit = chosen[1][2] if chosen else None
        unit_cell = None
        if chosen and not unit:
            vx, vy = center(chosen[0])
            vh = chosen[0]['bbox'][3] - chosen[0]['bbox'][1]
            units = []
            for cell in cells:
                embedded = NUMBER.fullmatch(cell['text'])
                observed_unit = embedded[2] if embedded else cell['text']
                if (observed_unit == spec['unit'] and cell['confidence'] >= .8
                        and cell['bbox'][2] >= chosen[0]['bbox'][2]
                        and abs(center(cell)[1] - vy) < vh*.8):
                    units.append(cell)
            if units:
                unit_cell = min(units, key=lambda c: c['bbox'][0])
                unit = spec['unit']
        stage = spec.get('stage')
        section = spec['section']
        state = 'unknown'
        if stage and section in counts:
            count = counts[section][0]
            state = 'enabled' if stage <= count else 'disabled'
            if label['text'].lower().startswith(('tp', 'vsl', 'sv')) and stage >= count:
                state = 'disabled'
            if section == 'injection' and visual_conflict:
                state = 'unknown'
        elif stage and section == 'injection' and re.fullmatch(r'v\d+', label['text'], re.I):
            state = visual_states.get(stage, 'unknown')
        elif stage and visual_counts.get(section) is not None:
            count = visual_counts[section]
            state = 'enabled' if stage <= count else 'disabled'
            if label['text'].lower().startswith(('tp', 'vsl', 'sv')) and stage >= count:
                state = 'disabled'
        if spec.get('label', '').startswith(('计量前', '计量后')) and chosen and min(label['confidence'], chosen[0]['confidence']) >= .8:
            state = retract_states.get(spec['label'][:3], 'unknown')
        reason = []
        if chosen and min(label['confidence'], chosen[0]['confidence']) < .8:
            reason.append('low_confidence')
        if not chosen:
            reason.append('value_missing_or_ambiguous')
        if not unit:
            reason.append('unit_unobserved')
        if stage and state == 'unknown':
            reason.append('visual_stage_count_conflict' if section == 'injection' and visual_conflict
                          else 'stage_count_unobserved')
        if spec.get('label', '').startswith(('计量前', '计量后')) and state == 'unknown':
            reason.append('visual_phase_state_unobserved')
        state_basis = None
        if state != 'unknown':
            if spec.get('label', '').startswith(('计量前', '计量后')):
                state_basis = 'grayscale_pb_reference'
            elif section == 'injection' and re.fullmatch(r'v\d+', label['text'], re.I) and stage in visual_states:
                state_basis = 'grayscale_v_row_reference'
        observations.append(dict(label=spec.get('label', label['text']), value=value, unit=unit,
            role=spec.get('role', 'setting'), section=section, stage=stage, state=state,
            state_basis=state_basis,
            text=chosen[0]['text'] if chosen else None,
            confidence=min(label['confidence'], chosen[0]['confidence']) if chosen else 0,
            bbox=chosen[0]['bbox'] if chosen else None, original_bbox=None,
            line_indexes=[label['index']] + ([spec['row_index']] if 'row_index' in spec else []) + ([chosen[0]['index']] if chosen else []) +
                         ([unit_cell['index']] if unit_cell else []), reasons=reason))
    located = {o['label'] for o in observations if o['value'] is not None}
    observations = [o for o in observations if o['value'] is not None or o['label'] not in located]
    for anchor_text, spec in template.get('enum_labels', {}).items():
        anchors = [c for c in cells if c['text'] == anchor_text]
        if len(anchors) != 1:
            continue
        anchor = anchors[0]
        ax, ay = center(anchor)
        candidates = [c for c in cells if c['text'] in spec['values'] and c['confidence'] >= .8
                      and ((spec.get('direction') == 'right'
                            and 0 < center(c)[0] - ax < width * .2
                            and abs(center(c)[1] - ay) < height * .05)
                           or (spec.get('direction') != 'right'
                               and abs(center(c)[0] - ax) < width * .1
                               and 0 < center(c)[1] - ay < (anchor['bbox'][3] - anchor['bbox'][1]) * 3))]
        if len(candidates) != 1:
            continue
        chosen = candidates[0]
        observations.append(dict(label=spec['label'], value=chosen['text'], unit=None,
            role='setting', section='scalar', stage=None, state='unknown', text=chosen['text'],
            confidence=min(anchor['confidence'], chosen['confidence']), bbox=chosen['bbox'],
            original_bbox=None, line_indexes=[anchor['index'], chosen['index']], reasons=[]))
    project_boxes(observations, meta)
    detail = dict(page_variant=template['layout_variant'], page_observations=dict(
        version='1.0', profile_id=template['profile_id'], coordinate_space='original_percent',
        fields=observations, stage_counts={k: dict(value=v, line_indexes=[c['index']])
                                         for k, (v, c) in counts.items()},
        visual_stage_counts={k: v for k, v in visual_counts.items() if v is not None}))
    # 只返回待确认观测，不生成旧版自动导入字段。
    return dict(fields={}, heater_columns=0, warnings=['TACT5_REVIEW_REQUIRED'], detail=detail)


def recover_stage_counts(ocr, image_path, lines, screen_size, missing):
    """仅对缺失且能定位到区域锚点与“段”字的段数局部重识别，返回补充 OCR 行。"""
    import cv2

    width, height = screen_size
    image = cv2.imread(str(image_path))
    if image is None:
        return []
    recovered = []
    for section, anchor_text in (('injection', '充填速度'), ('plasticizing', 'VS1')):
        if section not in missing:
            continue
        anchors = [line for line in lines if line['text'] == anchor_text]
        if len(anchors) != 1:
            continue
        anchor = anchors[0]['bbox']
        marks = []
        for line in lines:
            if line['text'] != '段' or line['conf'] < .7:
                continue
            box = line['bbox']
            if section == 'injection':
                near = (anchor['x_min'] <= box['x_min'] <= anchor['x_max'] + width*.06
                        and anchor['y_max'] < box['y_min'] < anchor['y_max'] + height*.08)
            else:
                near = (anchor['x_min'] < box['x_min'] < anchor['x_min'] + width*.15
                        and anchor['y_min'] - height*.09 < box['y_min'] < anchor['y_min'])
            if near:
                marks.append(line)
        if len(marks) != 1:
            continue
        mark = marks[0]['bbox']
        x1, y1 = max(0, int(mark['x_min'] - width*.065)), max(0, int(mark['y_min'] - height*.025))
        x2, y2 = min(width, int(mark['x_max'] + width*.02)), min(height, int(mark['y_max'] + height*.025))
        if x2 <= x1 or y2 <= y1:
            continue
        crop = cv2.resize(image[y1:y2, x1:x2], None, fx=3, fy=3,
                          interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)
        result = ocr.ocr(crop, cls=False)
        detected = result[0] if result and result[0] else []
        digits = [(box, text, conf) for box, (text, conf) in detected
                  if text in ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6') and conf >= .8]
        suffixes = [(box, conf) for box, (text, conf) in detected
                    if text == '段' and conf >= .8]
        if len(digits) != 1 or len(suffixes) != 1:
            continue
        number_box, digit, number_conf = digits[0]
        suffix_box, suffix_conf = suffixes[0]
        if max(p[0] for p in number_box) >= min(p[0] for p in suffix_box):
            continue
        points = number_box + suffix_box
        xs = [x1 + p[0]/3 for p in points]
        ys = [y1 + p[1]/3 for p in points]
        recovered.append(dict(text=digit + '段', conf=min(number_conf, suffix_conf),
                              bbox=dict(x_min=min(xs), y_min=min(ys),
                                        x_max=max(xs), y_max=max(ys))))
    return recovered


def recover_time_units(ocr, image_path, observations, template, screen_size):
    """仅重识别时间标量值右侧漏读的印刷单位 s，证据唯一且可信时返回补充 OCR 行。

    全屏 OCR 会漏掉射出/中间值旁的小字 s；裁剪区覆盖数值右缘并补白边，
    仅接受唯一高置信的 s 字形，大小写按模板单位归一。
    """
    import cv2

    specs = {spec.get('label', name): spec for name, spec in template.get('field_labels', {}).items()
             if spec.get('section') == 'scalar' and spec.get('direction') == 'right'
             and spec.get('unit') == 's'}
    if not specs:
        return []
    image = cv2.imread(str(image_path))
    if image is None:
        return []
    width, height = screen_size
    scale, pad = 3, 30
    recovered = []
    for observation in observations:
        if (observation.get('label') not in specs or observation.get('value') is None
                or observation.get('unit') is not None or not observation.get('bbox')):
            continue
        vx1, vy1, vx2, vy2 = observation['bbox']
        x1, y1 = max(0, int(vx2 - 4)), max(0, int(vy1 - height * .01))
        x2, y2 = min(width, int(vx2 + width * .05)), min(height, int(vy2 + height * .01))
        if x2 <= x1 or y2 <= y1:
            continue
        crop = cv2.resize(image[y1:y2, x1:x2], None, fx=scale, fy=scale,
                          interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)
        crop = cv2.copyMakeBorder(crop, pad, pad, pad, pad, cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,
                                  value=(255, 255, 255))
        result = ocr.ocr(crop, cls=False)
        detected = [(box, text, conf) for box, (text, conf) in
                    (result[0] if result and result[0] else []) if conf >= .8]
        glyphs = [(box, conf) for box, text, conf in detected
                  if text.strip().casefold() == 's']
        if len(detected) != 1 or len(glyphs) != 1:
            continue
        (glyph_box, glyph_conf), = glyphs
        xs = [x1 + (p[0] - pad) / scale for p in glyph_box]
        ys = [y1 + (p[1] - pad) / scale for p in glyph_box]
        if max(xs) < vx2:  # 单位字形须在数值右缘，不能落在数值框内
            continue
        recovered.append(dict(text='s', conf=glyph_conf, _src='tact5_unit_rescue',
                              bbox=dict(x_min=min(xs), y_min=min(ys),
                                        x_max=max(xs), y_max=max(ys))))
    return recovered

"""Shared geometric projection; coordinates retain the original-percent contract."""

def project_boxes(observations, meta):
    """用矫正时的屏幕四角将字段框投回原图百分比坐标；元数据缺失则保持未定位。"""
    if not meta.get('original_size') or not meta.get('screen_quad'):
        return
    import cv2
    import numpy as np
    from quality import order_points
    w, h = meta['screen_size']
    ow, oh = meta['original_size']
    src = np.array([[0, 0], [w-1, 0], [w-1, h-1], [0, h-1]], dtype=np.float32)
    matrix = cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(src, order_points(np.array(meta['screen_quad'], dtype=np.float32)))
    for observation in observations:
        if observation['bbox'] is None:
            continue
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = observation['bbox']
        corners = np.array([[[x1, y1], [x2, y1], [x2, y2], [x1, y2]]], dtype=np.float32)
        points = cv2.perspectiveTransform(corners, matrix)[0]
        box = [float(points[:, 0].min()/ow*100), float(points[:, 1].min()/oh*100),
               float(points[:, 0].max()/ow*100), float(points[:, 1].max()/oh*100)]
        if all(0 <= value <= 100 for value in box) and box[0] < box[2] and box[1] < box[3]:
            observation['original_bbox'] = box
sources.scripts/quality.py:
"""HMI 图片质量门禁。

输出 JSON 报告，对每张图给出：
- triage: green | yellow | red
- reject_codes: 拒绝原因码列表（来自 docs/002 的硬拒绝集）
- warn_codes: 警告原因码列表（黄灯）
- metrics: 各分项指标
- reshoot_guidance: 给现场操作员的重拍建议

硬拒绝原因码：
DUPLICATE_ATTACHMENT, CROSS_RECORD_DUPLICATE, SCREEN_NOT_FOUND, SCREEN_TOO_SMALL,
SEVERE_GLARE, SEVERE_BLUR, SEVERE_PERSPECTIVE, PAGE_UNKNOWN,
SCREEN_CLIPPED, SEVERE_UNDEREXPOSURE（064 S02 新增，五类原因映射见 064 PLAN §3.1）

警告原因码（黄灯）：
NEEDS_RECTIFICATION, LOW_TEXT_SIZE, MINOR_GLARE, LOW_CLASS_CONFIDENCE

判定策略（013 S1 校准集 2026-07-31 第二轮校准）：
- 用 OpenCV 检测屏幕区域：四边最长的水平/垂直线 + 暗色矩形估计
- 透视：有屏幕四角时取对边长度比（>1.80 且可矫正仍硬拒；无四角回退启发式 >1.30 硬拒）
- 反光：高亮区域比例（>230 像素值）>0.15 且画面纹理已破坏（Laplacian 方差 <300）才硬拒
- 模糊：Laplacian 方差
- 屏幕太小：屏幕有效宽度 < 500px 且屏占比 <30% 硬拒；仅一项不足时黄灯
- 完整性（064 S02）：屏幕 bbox 贴图像边（余量 <1%）且四角未命中时 SCREEN_CLIPPED
  硬拒；四角命中说明屏幕完整入镜，不误判。无法定界屏幕 ROI 时不下质量结论
  （安全降级，SCREEN_NOT_FOUND 已覆盖）
- 欠曝（064 S02）：屏幕 ROI 欠曝比例 >0.85 且纹理已破坏（blur<300）才
  SEVERE_UNDEREXPOSURE 硬拒；语料无欠曝样本，阈值保守取值待补采校准
- 多码命中（064 S02）：reject_codes 返回全部机器码，red 时 reshoot_guidance
  只保留一个主提示（按 REJECT_GUIDANCE 顺序取最可操作者），yellow 维持原多提示

用法：
    python scripts/quality.py <image>... --output <report.json>
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np


@dataclass
class QualityMetrics:
    width: int = 0
    height: int = 0
    screen_bbox: tuple[int, int, int, int] | None = None
    screen_area_ratio: float = 0.0
    perspective_ratio: float = 1.0  # 越大越倾斜
    blur_score: float = 0.0  # Laplacian variance
    glare_ratio: float = 0.0  # >230 像素比例
    dark_ratio: float = 0.0
    corners_found: bool = False  # detect_screen_corners 是否命中（命中则透视可被 rectify 矫正）
    screen_clipped: bool = False  # 屏幕 bbox 贴图像边且四角未命中（064 S02，疑似屏幕被裁切）
    roi_dark_ratio: float = 0.0  # 屏幕 ROI 内欠曝(<30)像素比例（064 S02；无 ROI 时保持 0 不强拒）


@dataclass
class QualityReport:
    filename: str
    triage: str = "green"  # green | yellow | red
    reject_codes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    warn_codes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metrics: QualityMetrics = field(default_factory=QualityMetrics)
    reshoot_guidance: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


# 阈值（013 S1 校准集 2026-07-31 第二轮校准：按误杀案例分析放宽，见 014 HANDOVER）
THRESHOLD_SCREEN_MIN_WIDTH = 500  # 绝对像素宽度下限（OCR 可用性取决于绝对像素，不取决于屏占比）
THRESHOLD_SCREEN_MIN_AREA_RATIO = 0.30  # 屏占比低于此值仅黄灯提示（高分辨率远景照绝对像素仍充足，不再红灯）
THRESHOLD_BLUR_VARIANCE = 30.0
THRESHOLD_GLARE_RATIO = 0.05
THRESHOLD_PERSPECTIVE = 1.30  # 无四角（不可矫正）时的硬拒阈值
THRESHOLD_PERSPECTIVE_RECTIFIABLE = 1.80  # 有四角（rectify 可矫正）时的硬拒阈值
# 反光硬拒需同时满足"纹理已被破坏"：白底高亮屏（如佳明过曝图）虽然 >230 比例高，
# 但 Laplacian 方差大（文字梯度仍在），OCR 可读，不应红灯
THRESHOLD_GLARE_SEVERE = 0.15
THRESHOLD_GLARE_BLUR_MAX = 300.0
# 064 S02 新增（五类原因补齐）：
THRESHOLD_EDGE_MARGIN_RATIO = 0.01  # 屏幕 bbox 距图像边不足 1% 视为贴边（疑似裁切）
THRESHOLD_DARK_SEVERE = 0.85  # 屏幕 ROI 欠曝比例硬拒下限（须同时 blur<300；语料无样本，保守值待补采校准）

# 064 S02：五类原因的硬拒码 → 中文重拍提示（064 PLAN §3.1 / 065 §3.1 冻结映射）。
# red 多码命中时 reject_codes 全部返回，reshoot_guidance 只保留列表中最靠前的一个主提示。
REJECT_GUIDANCE = {
    "SCREEN_CLIPPED": "屏幕未拍完整，请将完整屏幕框入取景框。",
    "SCREEN_NOT_FOUND": "请正对屏幕拍摄，四个屏幕边角全部入镜，不要从侧面斜拍。",
    "SEVERE_PERSPECTIVE": "请正对屏幕拍摄，四个屏幕边角全部入镜，不要从侧面斜拍。",
    "SCREEN_TOO_SMALL": "请靠近拍摄，让显示屏主体占照片大部分，同时保留完整四边。",
    "SEVERE_UNDEREXPOSURE": "画面过暗：请改善照明，确保屏幕数字区域清晰可辨后重拍。",
    "SEVERE_GLARE": "反光严重：请调整站位或关闭闪光灯，确保反光不覆盖数字区域。",
    "SEVERE_BLUR": "画面模糊：请擦净镜头、保持手机稳定，点击屏幕区域对焦后重拍。",
    "READ_ERROR": "图片无法读取，请重新拍照或检查文件格式。",
}


def detect_screen_bbox(img: np.ndarray) -> tuple[int, int, int, int] | None:
    """用暗色矩形估计屏幕四边，返回 (x, y, w, h)。

    启发式：屏幕通常有黑色边框 + 内部有亮色文本。找最大内部颜色方差的中等暗矩形。
    这里用简化方法：Canny + 形态学找最大轮廓 + 验证长宽比。
    """
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY) if len(img.shape) == 3 else img
    h, w = gray.shape

    # 边缘
    edges = cv2.Canny(gray, 50, 150)
    edges = cv2.dilate(edges, np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8), iterations=2)

    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(edges, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
    if not contours:
        return None

    # 取最大外接矩形（不做面积过滤，让 triage() 决定 SCREEN_TOO_SMALL）
    best = None
    best_area = 0
    for c in contours:
        x, y, cw, ch = cv2.boundingRect(c)
        area = cw * ch
        # 最低面积 1%（防止噪音框），不做精确过滤
        if area < h * w * 0.01:
            continue
        if cw < 200:  # 太窄的不要
            continue
        aspect = max(cw, ch) / max(1, min(cw, ch))
        if aspect > 4.0:  # 太扁的不要（很可能是边缘）
            continue
        if area > best_area:
            best_area = area
            best = (x, y, cw, ch)
    return best


def order_points(pts: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """把 4 个点排序为 [左上, 右上, 右下, 左下]。"""
    pts = np.asarray(pts, dtype=np.float32)
    s = pts.sum(axis=1)
    diff = np.diff(pts, axis=1).ravel()
    return np.array([
        pts[np.argmin(s)],      # 左上：x+y 最小
        pts[np.argmin(diff)],   # 右上：y-x 最小
        pts[np.argmax(s)],      # 右下：x+y 最大
        pts[np.argmax(diff)],   # 左下：y-x 最大
    ], dtype=np.float32)


def detect_screen_corners(img: np.ndarray,
                          bbox: tuple[int, int, int, int] | None = None) -> np.ndarray | None:
    """检测显示屏面板四角，返回 (4,2) 像素坐标 [左上, 右上, 右下, 左下]；失败返回 None。

    启发式：显示屏面板是图中最亮的低饱和区域（浅灰/白），边框与机身明显更暗。
    在缩略图上做 (V>140 且 S<90) 阈值 → 形态学闭/开 → 最大轮廓 →
    approxPolyDP 逼近四边形；逼近不出四点则用 minAreaRect 的旋转矩形四角。

    S4（2026-07-30）新增：供 rectify.py 透视矫正与 compute_perspective_ratio 真实测量复用。
    083 S05：传入 bbox（detect_screen_bbox 结果）时做子面板防护——局部亮区
    （如屏幕下半功能面板）被当作整屏会让矫正裁掉上部温度区；四角候选面积
    显著小于 bbox 且基本被其包含时判为子面板，返回 None 走 bbox 回退。
    """
    h, w = img.shape[:2]
    scale = 800 / max(h, w)
    small = cv2.resize(img, (int(w * scale), int(h * scale))) if scale < 1 else img.copy()
    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(small, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
    _, S, V = cv2.split(hsv)
    mask = ((V > 140) & (S < 90)).astype(np.uint8) * 255
    mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, np.ones((15, 15), np.uint8))
    mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, np.ones((7, 7), np.uint8))

    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
    sh, sw = mask.shape
    best, best_area = None, 0.0
    for c in contours:
        area = cv2.contourArea(c)
        if area < sh * sw * 0.05:  # 至少占图 5%，防噪声
            continue
        if area > best_area:
            best, best_area = c, area
    if best is None:
        return None

    inv = 1.0 / scale if scale < 1 else 1.0
    peri = cv2.arcLength(best, True)
    approx = cv2.approxPolyDP(best, 0.02 * peri, True)
    if len(approx) == 4:
        quad = approx.reshape(-1, 2).astype(np.float32) * inv
    else:
        quad = cv2.boxPoints(cv2.minAreaRect(best)).astype(np.float32) * inv

    quad = order_points(quad)
    # 基本合理性：四边都 > 100px（原图尺度），长宽比不过分离谱
    widths = [np.linalg.norm(quad[1] - quad[0]), np.linalg.norm(quad[2] - quad[3])]
    heights = [np.linalg.norm(quad[3] - quad[0]), np.linalg.norm(quad[2] - quad[1])]
    if min(widths + heights) < 100:
        return None
    aspect = max(widths) / max(1.0, min(heights))
    if not 0.4 <= aspect <= 4.0:
        return None
    if bbox is not None:
        bx, by, bw, bh = bbox
        if bw > 0 and bh > 0:
            qx0, qy0 = float(quad[:, 0].min()), float(quad[:, 1].min())
            qx1, qy1 = float(quad[:, 0].max()), float(quad[:, 1].max())
            mx, my = bw * 0.10, bh * 0.10
            inside = (qx0 >= bx - mx and qx1 <= bx + bw + mx
                      and qy0 >= by - my and qy1 <= by + bh + my)
            # 083 S07：bbox 已接近整幅（≥60% 图幅，整机面板被当成屏幕）且四角
            # 候选在 bbox 内均匀留边（上缘距 bbox 顶 ≤25% 高度）时，bbox 是
            # 「机器」而非「屏幕」——其内部四角候选（真 LCD）不应被子面板防护
            # 否决（伯乐 500EKS 竖屏整机实拍 bbox 占 79%、真屏上缘距仅 6% 被误杀；
            # 伯乐 Z001 斜拍 bbox 占 72%、真屏上缘距 5%）。S05 原子面板场景
            # （EST Luban：局部亮区 quad 深陷屏幕 bbox 下半部，上缘距 42%、
            # 下缘距 2%）不满足豁免，防护行为不变。
            bbox_is_frame = bw * bh >= 0.6 * (w * h)
            quad_evenly_nested = (qy0 - by) <= 0.25 * bh
            # 083 S09：整机面板上缘留白较大（手写告示/机台 logo 占顶部 >25%）时
            # 真屏四角仍被误杀（伯乐 TX25024 720px 整机照，真屏四缘留边
            # 17%~44% 均匀居中）。四缘留边均 ≥10% 的居中候选与「贴顶真屏」
            # 一样不是局部亮面子面板，同样豁免；S05 EST 子面板（下缘距 2%
            # 贴底）不满足四缘条件，防护行为不变。
            all_margins = (qx0 - bx >= 0.10 * bw and bx + bw - qx1 >= 0.10 * bw
                           and qy0 - by >= 0.10 * bh and by + bh - qy1 >= 0.10 * bh)
            exempt = bbox_is_frame and (quad_evenly_nested or all_margins)
            if (inside and not exempt
                    and cv2.contourArea(quad) < 0.55 * bw * bh):
                return None
    return quad


def compute_perspective_ratio(bbox: tuple[int, int, int, int] | None, gray: np.ndarray,
                              quad: np.ndarray | None = None) -> float:
    """估计屏幕透视畸变程度，>=1.0，越大越倾斜。

    S4 起为真实测量（修正此前"名为透视、实为长宽比罚分"的名不副实问题）：
    有屏幕四角（detect_screen_corners）时取对边长度比
    max(上/下, 下/上, 左/右, 右/左)——正对屏幕拍摄时平行边等长，比值≈1.0；
    斜拍时近大远小，比值增大。

    四角不可得时回退旧启发式：屏幕长宽比偏离 [0.7, 2.5] 罚 1.3；屏幕被图像边
    严重裁切罚 1.5。阈值（THRESHOLD_PERSPECTIVE=1.30）两种口径下语义一致。
    """
    if quad is not None:
        q = order_points(quad)
        top = float(np.linalg.norm(q[1] - q[0]))
        bottom = float(np.linalg.norm(q[2] - q[3]))
        left = float(np.linalg.norm(q[3] - q[0]))
        right = float(np.linalg.norm(q[2] - q[1]))
        ratios = []
        for a, b in ((top, bottom), (left, right)):
            lo, hi = min(a, b), max(a, b)
            if lo > 0:
                ratios.append(hi / lo)
        return max(ratios) if ratios else 1.0

    if bbox is None:
        return 1.0
    x, y, bw, bh = bbox
    # 检查屏幕长宽比是否在合理范围（屏幕本身通常宽 > 高，或接近方形）
    aspect = bw / max(bh, 1)
    # 屏幕长宽比偏离 [0.7, 2.5] -> 罚分
    if 0.7 <= aspect <= 2.5:
        aspect_penalty = 1.0
    else:
        aspect_penalty = 1.3

    # 屏幕被图像边严重裁切（边界外推 > 50px）-> reject
    h, w = gray.shape
    margin = 50
    heavily_clipped = (x < -margin or y < -margin
                       or x + bw > w + margin or y + bh > h + margin)
    if heavily_clipped:
        return 1.5  # 严重

    return aspect_penalty


def measure_perspective(image_path: Path) -> float:
    """测量指定图像的透视畸变比（083 S05：管线对矫正图复测透视专用）。

    与 assess 内部同一口径（compute_perspective_ratio），但不触发其他判据——
    模糊/反光/裁切/尺寸等仍在原图上评估，只有「透视」这一项在矫正后的实际
    OCR 输入上复测。读取失败返回 inf（复测失败，维持原拒识）。
    """
    img = cv2.imread(str(image_path))
    if img is None:
        return float("inf")
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    bbox = detect_screen_bbox(img)
    quad = detect_screen_corners(img)
    return compute_perspective_ratio(bbox, gray, quad)


def compute_blur(gray: np.ndarray) -> float:
    return float(cv2.Laplacian(gray, cv2.CV_64F).var())


def compute_glare(gray: np.ndarray) -> float:
    high = (gray > 230).sum()
    total = gray.size
    return float(high / total) if total else 0.0


def compute_dark(gray: np.ndarray) -> float:
    low = (gray < 30).sum()
    total = gray.size
    return float(low / total) if total else 0.0


def estimate_text_size(bbox: tuple[int, int, int, int] | None) -> int | None:
    """基于屏幕高度估计最小数字字符像素高度（启发式：屏幕高度的 5%）。"""
    if bbox is None:
        return None
    return int(bbox[3] * 0.05)


def triage(report: QualityReport) -> None:
    m = report.metrics
    tri = "green"
    reshoot = []

    if m.screen_bbox is None:
        report.reject_codes.append("SCREEN_NOT_FOUND")
        tri = "red"
        reshoot.append(REJECT_GUIDANCE["SCREEN_NOT_FOUND"])

    # 064 S02 完整性独立机器码：bbox 贴图像边且四角未命中 → 屏幕疑似被裁切。
    # 四角命中说明屏幕完整入镜；bbox 缺失（SCREEN_NOT_FOUND）时不重复判裁切。
    if m.screen_bbox is not None and m.screen_clipped:
        report.reject_codes.append("SCREEN_CLIPPED")
        tri = "red"
        reshoot.append(REJECT_GUIDANCE["SCREEN_CLIPPED"])

    if m.screen_bbox is not None:
        x, y, bw, bh = m.screen_bbox
        if (bw < THRESHOLD_SCREEN_MIN_WIDTH
                and m.screen_area_ratio < THRESHOLD_SCREEN_MIN_AREA_RATIO):
            report.reject_codes.append("SCREEN_TOO_SMALL")
            tri = "red"
            reshoot.append(REJECT_GUIDANCE["SCREEN_TOO_SMALL"])
        # 最小数字字符像素
        text_h = estimate_text_size(m.screen_bbox)
        if text_h is not None and text_h < 14:
            report.warn_codes.append("LOW_TEXT_SIZE")
            if tri == "green":
                tri = "yellow"
            reshoot.append("屏幕内的数字太小，请靠近拍摄让数字字符清晰可辨。")

    if m.perspective_ratio > (THRESHOLD_PERSPECTIVE_RECTIFIABLE if m.corners_found else THRESHOLD_PERSPECTIVE):
        report.reject_codes.append("SEVERE_PERSPECTIVE")
        tri = "red"
        reshoot.append(REJECT_GUIDANCE["SEVERE_PERSPECTIVE"])
    elif m.perspective_ratio > 1.10:
        report.warn_codes.append("NEEDS_RECTIFICATION")
        if tri == "green":
            tri = "yellow"

    if m.blur_score < THRESHOLD_BLUR_VARIANCE:
        report.reject_codes.append("SEVERE_BLUR")
        tri = "red"
        reshoot.append(REJECT_GUIDANCE["SEVERE_BLUR"])

    if m.glare_ratio > THRESHOLD_GLARE_SEVERE and m.blur_score < THRESHOLD_GLARE_BLUR_MAX:
        report.reject_codes.append("SEVERE_GLARE")
        tri = "red"
        reshoot.append(REJECT_GUIDANCE["SEVERE_GLARE"])
    elif m.glare_ratio > 0.05:
        report.warn_codes.append("MINOR_GLARE")
        if tri == "green":
            tri = "yellow"
    elif m.glare_ratio > 0.02:
        report.warn_codes.append("MINOR_GLARE")
        if tri == "green":
            tri = "yellow"

    # 064 S02 欠曝独立机器码：仅基于屏幕 ROI（不用全图背景做强拒识），
    # 且须纹理已被破坏（blur<300），避免误伤暗底亮字的数码管面板。
    if (m.screen_bbox is not None and m.roi_dark_ratio > THRESHOLD_DARK_SEVERE
            and m.blur_score < THRESHOLD_GLARE_BLUR_MAX):
        report.reject_codes.append("SEVERE_UNDEREXPOSURE")
        tri = "red"
        reshoot.append(REJECT_GUIDANCE["SEVERE_UNDEREXPOSURE"])

    # 屏幕占比过低：只黄灯提示。OCR 可用性取决于屏幕绝对像素宽度（上方 width 规则），
    # 高分辨率远景照屏占比低但绝对像素充足（校准集 rank06 2525px / rank11 2366px 宽被误杀）
    if m.screen_bbox is not None and m.screen_area_ratio < THRESHOLD_SCREEN_MIN_AREA_RATIO:
        report.warn_codes.append("LOW_TEXT_SIZE")
        if tri == "green":
            tri = "yellow"
        reshoot.append("屏幕占照片比例偏低：建议靠近拍摄，让显示屏主体占照片大部分。")

    # 064 S02：red 多码命中时只保留一个主提示（REJECT_GUIDANCE 声明顺序即优先级）；
    # yellow/green 维持原有多提示行为不变。
    if tri == "red":
        for code, guidance in REJECT_GUIDANCE.items():
            if code in report.reject_codes:
                reshoot = [guidance]
                break

    report.triage = tri
    report.reshoot_guidance = reshoot


def assess(image_path: Path) -> QualityReport:
    img = cv2.imread(str(image_path))
    if img is None:
        r = QualityReport(filename=image_path.name)
        r.reject_codes.append("READ_ERROR")
        r.triage = "red"
        r.reshoot_guidance.append(REJECT_GUIDANCE["READ_ERROR"])
        return r
    h, w = img.shape[:2]
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)

    bbox = detect_screen_bbox(img)
    # 083 S05：子面板防护只作用于 rectify 的矫正分支；质量门禁保持原口径
    # （四角命中即视为屏幕完整入镜，不判裁切）。
    quad = detect_screen_corners(img)
    # 083 S09：bbox/四角反向失配修复——整机实拍里 Canny 外轮廓可能只闭合
    # 屏幕内部某个小组件（伯乐 KEBA 整机照的键盘小窗 395px），而四角检测
    # 命中的最大亮区才是真 LCD（2271px）。当四角包围盒完整包含 bbox 且面积
    # 显著更大（≥2 倍）时，bbox 是屏幕内部子区域而非屏幕本体，改用四角
    # 包围盒作为屏幕区域证据（占比/文本高度/欠曝 ROI 随之按真屏评估）。
    # S05 子面板场景（四角亮区面积小于 bbox）方向相反，不触发本修复。
    if bbox is not None and quad is not None:
        qx0, qy0 = float(quad[:, 0].min()), float(quad[:, 1].min())
        qx1, qy1 = float(quad[:, 0].max()), float(quad[:, 1].max())
        bx, by, bw, bh = bbox
        mx, my = (qx1 - qx0) * 0.10, (qy1 - qy0) * 0.10
        contains = (bx >= qx0 - mx and bx + bw <= qx1 + mx
                    and by >= qy0 - my and by + bh <= qy1 + my)
        if contains and (qx1 - qx0) * (qy1 - qy0) >= 2.0 * bw * bh:
            bbox = (int(qx0), int(qy0), int(qx1 - qx0), int(qy1 - qy0))
    # 064 S02：贴边/欠曝判据只基于屏幕 ROI；四角命中视为屏幕完整入镜，不判裁切。
    screen_clipped = False
    roi_dark_ratio = 0.0
    if bbox:
        x, y, bw, bh = bbox
        roi = gray[max(y, 0):y + bh, max(x, 0):x + bw]
        if roi.size:
            roi_dark_ratio = compute_dark(roi)
        if quad is None:
            mx = max(1, int(w * THRESHOLD_EDGE_MARGIN_RATIO))
            my = max(1, int(h * THRESHOLD_EDGE_MARGIN_RATIO))
            screen_clipped = (x <= mx or y <= my
                              or x + bw >= w - mx or y + bh >= h - my)
    metrics = QualityMetrics(
        width=w,
        height=h,
        screen_bbox=bbox,
        screen_area_ratio=(bbox[2] * bbox[3] / (w * h)) if bbox else 0.0,
        perspective_ratio=compute_perspective_ratio(bbox, gray, quad),
        blur_score=compute_blur(gray),
        glare_ratio=compute_glare(gray),
        dark_ratio=compute_dark(gray),
        corners_found=quad is not None,
        screen_clipped=screen_clipped,
        roi_dark_ratio=roi_dark_ratio,
    )

    r = QualityReport(filename=image_path.name, metrics=metrics)
    triage(r)
    return r


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("images", nargs="+")
    ap.add_argument("--output", "-o", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--dedup", help="可选：dedup JSON 路径，把重复文件直接标记为红灯")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    dup_hashes = set()
    if args.dedup:
        dedup_report = json.loads(Path(args.dedup).read_text())
        for grp in dedup_report.get("duplicate_within_record", []):
            dup_hashes.add(grp["sha256"])
        for grp in dedup_report.get("duplicate_across_records", []):
            dup_hashes.add(grp["sha256"])

    reports = []
    counts = {"green": 0, "yellow": 0, "red": 0}
    for img_str in args.images:
        p = Path(img_str)
        if not p.is_file():
            continue
        r = assess(p)
        # 标记重复文件
        if dup_hashes:
            import hashlib
            digest = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            if digest in dup_hashes:
                r.reject_codes.append("DUPLICATE_ATTACHMENT")
                if r.triage == "green":
                    r.triage = "yellow"
                r.reshoot_guidance.append("当前多个字段使用了同一张照片，请分别拍摄并上传对应页面。")
        counts[r.triage] += 1
        reports.append(asdict(r))

    out = {
        "summary": {
            "total": len(reports),
            "green": counts["green"],
            "yellow": counts["yellow"],
            "red": counts["red"],
        },
        "reports": reports,
    }
    out_path = Path(args.output)
    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_path.write_text(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    print(f"[quality] {len(reports)} images -> green={counts['green']} yellow={counts['yellow']} red={counts['red']}")
    print(f"[quality] report -> {args.output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
